integrity.computational_scope: all 2^(2n) arrays for each 1<=n<=8, one canonical representative per symmetry orbit; two exact signature algorithms
integrity.proof_type: finite exhaustive exact-integer enumeration with fully supplied source; explicit reciprocal-factor witness

scientific_limitations: Exhaustive classification only for full-support two-row ±1 arrays of widths 1–8 under global sign and simultaneous central inversion, with full continuous-torus intensity. No result for wider arrays, finite-grid-only data, or larger alphabets. Priority against all earlier specialist homometry tables is not independently certified.
title: First and complete small-width Fourier-intensity ambiguities for binary two-row arrays
